Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Speed limits on the speed pages are statutory defaults that end with or the posted speed limit; C keeps that qualifier on every limit [A04].
School zone hours are described as common hours, not fixed law, and local authorities may set lower limits; C keeps that framing [A05].
The drowsy-driving statistics on the drowsy-driving page are national estimates and study findings as printed in the manual; they are taught as the manual's figures, not as Indiana counts [A09] (verify IN-SAFEONE-D-STATS).
The stopping-distance chart and the rollover, fuel and flood statistics are kept with their page and are not combined into new figures.
